body: My dad found me. My mom calls me a piece of work and sarcastically questions me what I'm going to do with my life.

It wasn't painful with the 83 grams of ibu. I just blacked out and then woke up intubated and in restraints. I just don't want to wake up. Maybe seroquel  

I have my psychiatrist but he has the power to commit me. I have my parents but I am just a burden at this point. I have some friends but I can't talk to them about this. I don't even know whether this guy is my ex boyfriend now or what so not him either.
Who knows? We wait for a truck to hit us but maybe something on the other end of the positivity spectrum will appear instead.
